name: Rangiri Dambulla Cave Temple
description: Rising 160 metres above the plains of central Sri Lanka, this rock hides a cave monastery that pilgrims have visited for some 22 centuries. Five main caves are filled with 157 statues, mostly of the Buddha, and walls and ceilings covered by 2,100 square metres of painted murals. Scenes include the Buddha's first sermon and his temptation by the demon Mara.
